method.branch_source: Fresh all-pages REST branches snapshot; exact tips replayed into repository tools/branch_inventory.py.
method.ancestry: Complete non-shallow git rev-list and merge-base.
method.patch_equivalence: git cherry exact nonmerge patch IDs; does not prove evolved semantics or merge-only changes.
method.path_equivalence: Compare each branch main-merge-base change path new blob against exact candidate tree.
method.merge_conflicts: git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only --no-messages main tip; no checkout/ref changes.
method.review_limit: This is a complete mechanical inventory and conservative disposition, not exhaustive semantic certification or fresh review/check acceptance.
method.closure_rule: No PR is authorized for closure by patch equivalence or this inventory alone; verify valuable behavior in qualified main and cite replacement.
